# Reviewed evidence repairs · research 0.73

The live student matcher is unchanged. Ten structured answer-to-evidence rules were repaired, seven formerly unused follow-up types were connected to reviewed constructs, and up to four additional unasked items were targeted per model. No frozen profile preference, existing Yes/No/Unsure/hold, scoring threshold, ranking, education route, pay or budget was changed.

## Paired results

| Cohort | Models | Supported Top, 0.71 → 0.73 | Bachelor/graduate Top | Graduate Top | Top covers budget |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| All public | 1000 | 818 → 820 | 691 → 696 | 158 → 158 | 258 → 258 |
| Development | 758 | 614 → 616 | 516 → 519 | 112 → 112 | 197 → 197 |
| Original holdout | 30 | 27 → 27 | 22 → 24 | 6 → 6 | 10 → 10 |
| Fresh holdout | 12 | 11 → 11 | 11 → 11 | 5 → 5 | 3 → 3 |
| Expanded holdout | 200 | 166 → 166 | 142 → 142 | 35 → 35 | 48 → 48 |

All prior supported alternatives survive. This round has no Top, degree, graduate or lifestyle coverage losses. Bachelor/graduate means a college or graduate route, excluding associate-only routes. Top stays capped at three. Degree support anywhere increases from 758 to 763; 67 models still have degree support only outside Top. All education levels and earnings remain inspectable.

## Attribution

Saved-answer binding repairs fill 46 missing checks and add 13 career claims. Connecting seven formerly unused response types changes evidence checks but adds no further supported career or Top coverage. Better targeting offers 196 additional questions: 10 grounded positive answers and 186 unknowns. It adds exercise physiology to Hayden Singh’s existing Top three. This changes his list, but adds no newly covered model because he already had Top and degree matches. All 992 previous responses, including unknowns, are reused without re-asking.

Three new context drafts concern workflow review, public group updates and supply changes. All 12 invitations to these drafts remain unknown. They are authored research questions, not externally validated scales. The seven repaired types concern physical models, research reports, event commitments, technical safety, curriculum review, educator coaching and client budgets. A choice supplies only the reviewed construct, not unrelated career or responsibility preferences. Curriculum review does not imply educator coaching.

Positive simulation reuses exact frozen structured facts; it is not an independent new observation. Source references are deduplicated. Unknown interests remain unknown. Targeting uses unresolved checks and concrete evidence, never predicted answers, demographics, identity, education or pay.

## Qualitative inspection of every new claim

Internal review of all 14 claims, not independent validation. Statistical assistance is narrower than research leadership. Workflow improvement does not imply investment analysis. Biology and a chosen repeatable laboratory routine are required together. Exercise physiology needs more than sport or movement interest.

Three claims have negative overall interest correlation: Evelyn Duarte / Management Analysts, Alexei Petrov / Statistical Assistants, and Alex Nowak / Biological Technicians. The first two account for the two newly covered Top models. Their specific choices pass the existing task-evidence gates, but disagreement with broad interests is unresolved. The coverage gain alone does not establish better final recommendations. No correlation threshold was relaxed.

## Remaining gaps

180 models still lack a supported Top and 304 lack a bachelor/graduate Top. The next useful step is new student evidence: a few neutral activity comparisons to resolve broad-versus-specific disagreements and specialist contexts, followed by actual student evaluation. Repeated inference over the same frozen facts cannot supply missing interests. Keep unfamiliar options, existing specialist holds, and the missing vision/farm-production evidence intact.

Previously inspected holdouts are diagnostic, not pristine validation. Synthetic coverage does not measure real student outcomes, typical completion or externally calibrated predictive accuracy. The original freeze and script are retained with a caption-only reporting amendment: the prose count was corrected from eleven to ten rules, with no policy or outcome change after results were seen. Reproducible scripts, rule tests, full cohort checks, per-answer decisions and source hashes are retained in research/evidence-073.
